stem.text: A lead pellet is shot vertically upwards into a clay block that is stationary at the moment of impact but is able to rise freely after impact.

stem.alt: A rounded rectangular block labelled stationary clay block, mass 95 g, above a lead pellet, mass 5.0 g. An upward arrow between the pellet and the block is labelled impact velocity 200 m s−1.

stem.text: The mass of the pellet is $5.0\,\text{g}$ and the mass of the clay block is $95\,\text{g}$.
The pellet hits the block with an initial vertical velocity of $200\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. It embeds itself in the block and does not emerge.
How high above its initial position will the block rise?
